findings.description: This creates a persistent IAM user access key rather than using federated, temporary credentials. If the key is exposed or retained by a user, it remains usable until manually disabled or rotated.

The policy grants full EC2, S3, Lambda, and CloudWatch permissions on every resource. This violates least privilege and can allow broad data access, infrastructure modification, and privilege-escalation paths through those services.
